title: Parseval's identity for $\pm 1$-valued functions
statement:
Let $f \colon \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function that is $\pm 1$-valued, meaning $f(x) \in \{-1,1\}$ for every $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then its Fourier--Walsh coefficients satisfy
\[
  \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} \hat f(S)^2 \;=\; 1,
\]
the sum ranging over all subsets $S$ of $[n]$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
